model_selection.model_build_reason: The single bounded design.optimize_math call returned two tied proposals, math-compliant-4795c8184616 and math-stiff-cccc020c6300, both at near 0.15 m, far 0.11 m, section scale 0.95, with identical primary residual upper bound (0.002 m, ratio 0.2 of the 0.01 m tolerance) and identical matrix evidence (world-x position-control row norm 0, shape [210]). I select the compliant proposal because the secondary lexicographic component, the feasible-witness normalized input energy, is lower for compliant (4.3677e-05) than for stiff (8.4636e-05). Because build with a saved source is not supported, I materialize exactly those selected near/far/scale/material values as changes on the frozen baseline, which is the required solve-free construction step; this configuration (0.15/0.11/0.95/compliant) is not among the excluded historical evaluated configurations.

rationale_evidence.applicability: controller-start frozen local affine exact-ZOH model
limitations: Local unconstrained frozen Jacobians; finite Gramians do not establish unilateral bounded-input feasibility.
Open-loop authority does not establish closed-loop stability, settling, or real-time execution.
Numerical agreement is implementation verification, not physical model validation.
Saved non-equilibrium frequency curves are frozen-Jacobian resolvents, not measured steady-state responses.

The objective can favor geometric alignment at the straight controller-start configuration; it does not predict nonlinear bending, closed-loop reach, settling, real-time performance, or global optimality.
Terminal braking and other sampled configurations are not aggregated into this optimization objective.
Candidate residuals are upper bounds; only explicit separating-direction records may certify local infeasibility.
Scenario winners and ties are bounded-search proposals, not global optima.

citation_review.finding: The model chose and built the exact returned compliant configuration, but renamed the proposal when binding the report; the build label is not the optimizer candidate_id.

backend_spending_decision.decision_text: Treat the attached advisory evidence as recommending one backend validation of this changed build; execute the saved build once, then read its official evaluation and profile report before any further physical search.
